{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' from string to float, handling thousands separators
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders from LOYAL customers
loyal_completed = sales_df[
    (sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') &
    (sales_df['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Compute the mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue'].mean()

mean_revenue"}
